messages:
alina: starting rollout for fetcher-service v1.9.0 to eu-west in 10m. preflight SLO checks on. tagging @omar for canary knobs.

deploy-bot: Rollout initiated: canary 10% -> target 60%, image=redwood/fetcher:1.9.0, id=rw-2499

slo-bot: Preflight window (5m): p95 baseline=140ms, canary p95=160ms (+14%), errors baseline=0.12%, canary=0.45% (spike).

omar: seeing the p95 bump and increased 5xxs on the canary pods. Any matching logs?

chris: quick grep in canary logs: repeated database timeout errors "db query timeout after 2s" and a handful of connection reset messages. Also one pod shows OOM events during startup.

alina: hold further traffic shift. @deploy-bot pause-canary. Mark as PAUSED and create incident ticket.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10% by alina. Status=PAUSED. Incident created: RW-INC-6120 "fetcher v1.9.0 canary 5xx + p95 spike"

omar: recommend rollback to 1.8.4 and schedule perf trace tomorrow. +1 to rollback.

alina: rollback issued. @deploy-bot rollback-canary fetcher-service to redwood/fetcher:1.8.4. Adding release-note: "rollback: v1.9.0 due to DB timeouts on canary"

slo-bot: Post-rollback quick metrics (1m): p95=138ms, errors=0.10%. Canary stabilized.

alina: good. hold full rollout until infra/DB team triages. Filing follow-up RW-ENG-7332 and noting items for changelog.
